scope.description: Whole sympy application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Symbolic expressions, simplification, algebra/equations, calculus, matrices, discrete mathematics, geometry and code generation.

coverage.rationale: One polynomial task covers a very small part of symbolic mathematics; symbolic calculus and broader solving are absent.

scope.description: Exact rational univariate real-root isolation with multiplicities and rational-width goals.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: A polynomial and interval-width goal hide isolation algorithms and exact-arithmetic certificates with task-level outputs.

limitations: Degree 1-12 rational polynomials only; bounded coefficients/width, no complex roots, multivariate systems or arbitrary symbolic expressions.
